doc.brief: The QWhatsThis class provides a simple description of any widget, i.e. answering the question "What's This?".
doc.index_brief: Simple description of any widget, i.e. answering the question "What's This?"

QAction * createAction(QObject *parent).brief: Returns a ready-made [QAction](xref:qt:QAction), used to invoke "What's This?" context help, with the given *parent*.

bool inWhatsThisMode().brief: Returns `true` if the user interface is in "What's This?" mode; otherwise returns `false`.

void enterWhatsThisMode().brief: This function switches the user interface into "What's This?" mode.

void hideText().brief: If a "What's This?" window is showing, this destroys it.

void leaveWhatsThisMode().brief: If the user interface is in "What's This?" mode, this function switches back to normal mode; otherwise it does nothing.

void showText(const QPoint &pos, const Q.brief: Shows *text* as a "What's This?" window, at global position *pos*.
